title: Leaving a page with unsaved changes gives no warning; edits are lost
steps: Click Service Account (top bar) to open My Personnel Details
Type in Middle Name: Save Changes becomes enabled
Hover Flight Operations in the sidebar and click Dashboard
expected: Guide §3: 'The current page has unsaved changes...' modal with Cancel (stay) and Continue (leave).
actual: Dashboard opens immediately, no modal; the typed change is discarded. Retest 22/10/2026 (v2.0.112): still fails. The shell side now works: main/index.js has checkIframeDirtyState() (window.isDirty() or window.parent.setDirty()), and with setDirty(true) forced the Unsaved Changes modal shows, Cancel stays with the edit kept and Continue leaves. But personneldetails never reports dirty: after typing in Middle Name (Save Changes enabled) it has no window.isDirty and never calls parent.setDirty, so the sidebar and top-bar still leave with no prompt and the edit is lost. Retest 2 22/10/2026 after the personneldetails update: fixed. personneldetails now exposes window.isDirty() (false when clean, true after typing). With an unsaved edit, the sidebar and top-bar both show the Unsaved Changes modal. Cancel stays with the edit kept, Continue leaves without saving, and reload triggers the beforeunload prompt. A clean page or a just-saved page leaves with no prompt.
cause: Shell is fixed; personneldetails/index.js has to expose window.isDirty() or call window.parent.setDirty(true/false) when its form changes and after save.

title: Unit Converter: NM <-> Statute Miles conversion inverted; large values shown in scientific notation
steps: Calculator > Unit Converter > Distance, Convert From = Nautical Miles (NM).
Enter 100.

Statute Miles = **86.8974 mi** (that is the mi->NM figure). Meters shows `1.852e+05 m`, Feet `6.076e+05 ft`.
Reverse direction (100 mi -> NM) is also inverted per source (gives 115.08 NM instead of 86.90 NM).
cause:
`Views/Calculator/UnitConverterView.swift`, distance units:
```swift
ConvUnit(name: "Statute Miles", abbrev: "mi", toBase: { $0 * 1.852 / 1.60934 }, fromBase: { $0 * 1.60934 / 1.852 }),
```
Base unit is NM; the factors are swapped. Fix: `toBase: { $0 * 1.60934 / 1.852 }, fromBase: { $0 * 1.852 / 1.60934 }`.

title: Leg times pulled from DataHangar ("HH:MM:SS") display as the current time; editing overwrites them
module: iPad app — Flights > Leg Detail > Route & Times (also time engine)
steps: Push a flight with leg times from the app (or create one on the website), then Pull / download it so the app stores the server copy.
Open the flight > Leg 1.
expected: Start/Takeoff/Landing/Stop show the server times (#42914: 23:07, 23:08, 00:07, 01:07).
actual: All four show the current device time (02:13 AM in 12h mode / 02:14 in 24h mode). The local store still holds "23:07:00" etc.
cause:
`FlightSyncService` maps `engineStart`/`flightStart`/`flightStop`/`engineStop` verbatim; the server returns `HH:MM:SS`.
`TimeUtils.parseHHMM` accepts only `HH:MM` (2 parts) or `HHMM`; 3 parts -> nil. `TimeUtils.dateFromHHMM` then returns `Date()`, which the leg DatePicker binds to, so the picker shows "now" and any interaction commits "now" via `phase.onCommit(hhmmFromDate(...))`.

title: Flight downloaded before aircraft sync keeps aircraft "None" forever; Pull never re-links; push fails with "(nil)"
steps: Log the app in as a user who cannot sync aircraft yet (no Resources permission), or download a flight before running Sync All.
Download BETA flight #42914 (ZK-HEL on the website).
Grant the user aircraft access (Resources + W&B Config Download) and run Sync All. Aircraft now sync.

- Pull (`~line 195`) reuses `localFlight.aircraftId` and never re-resolves it.

title: Safety Report form attached in iPad app is silently lost on push

title: Live Tracking queue stores duplicate/stale pings; rejected pings are dropped
steps: Start tracking on #42914 (30 s interval) with the device stationary.

Inspect UserDefaults lt_pendingPings.
